Technical SEO

Findings

  • 71 sitemap URL(s) have a canonical mismatch.
  • Deprecated sitemap tags like priority/changefreq are present.
  • LCP is above target at 2.95s.
  • INP is above target at 500ms.
  • IndexNow support was not detected.

Recommended Fixes

  • Prioritize the hero/LCP element, reduce render-blocking resources, and compress above-the-fold assets.
  • Reduce main-thread JavaScript work and defer non-critical third-party scripts.
  • Consider IndexNow if faster Bing/Yandex discovery matters to the publishing workflow.

Content Quality

Findings

  • Author or expert attribution signals are limited or absent in the visible content.

Recommended Fixes

  • Add explicit author, founder, reviewer, or expert attribution where it fits the page type.

On-Page SEO

Findings

  • Title tag length (74) is outside the ideal range.
  • Meta description length (187) is outside the typical range.
  • 66 page(s) have title tags longer than 60 characters.
  • 61 page(s) have meta descriptions longer than 160 characters.

Recommended Fixes

  • Tighten the title tag so it stays in the 50-60 character band where possible.
  • Shorten long title tags to 50-60 characters for optimal SERP display.
  • Trim meta descriptions to 150-160 characters to avoid truncation.

Schema & Structured Data

Findings

  • Recommended schema type(s) are missing: WebPage, WebSite.

Recommended Fixes

  • Add WebPage, WebSite markup aligned with the current page intent.

Performance

Findings

  • LCP is above target at 2.94s.
  • INP is above target at 500ms.
  • CLS is above target at 0.170.
  • Real-user/PageSpeed performance data was unavailable, so the report uses deterministic lab heuristics.

Recommended Fixes

  • Prioritize the hero/LCP element, reduce render-blocking resources, and compress above-the-fold assets.
  • Reduce main-thread JavaScript work and defer non-critical third-party scripts.
  • Reserve space for images/components and avoid late-injected layout shifts.
  • Provide PAGESPEED_API_KEY or re-run in an environment with PageSpeed API access for richer CWV evidence.

Images

Findings

  • 10 image(s) use weak or filename-like alt text.
  • 2 image(s) are missing width/height attributes.
  • 1 image(s) exceed the 200KB warning threshold.
  • 6 sampled image(s) still use legacy raster formats.
  • 11 below-the-fold sampled image(s) are not lazy loaded.

Recommended Fixes

  • Replace generic alt text with concise content descriptions.
  • Add intrinsic dimensions or reserve space with CSS aspect-ratio to reduce CLS.
  • Compress oversized images and prioritize WebP/AVIF for large raster assets.
  • Adopt WebP or AVIF for compatible browsers while keeping fallbacks where needed.
  • Use native loading="lazy" on below-the-fold images only.

AI Search Readiness

Findings

  • No strong 134-167 word self-contained answer block was detected.
  • The page has limited question-based heading structure for AI extraction patterns.
  • Author/date attribution is weak in the visible content.
  • Server-rendered content confirmation is weak without technical-cache support.

Recommended Fixes

  • Add one or more self-contained 134-167 word answer blocks near key H2 sections.
  • Add question-based H2/H3 headings to improve AI extraction and citation patterns.
  • Add visible author, founder, reviewer, or updated-date signals to strengthen authority and trust.

Sitemap Quality

Findings

  • 71 sitemap URL(s) have a canonical mismatch.
  • Deprecated sitemap tags like priority/changefreq are present.

Recommended Fixes

  • Align sitemap entries with self-canonical URLs only.

Final Assessment

www.metasoftco.com scores 61/100 overall. The site has solid foundations but several areas need attention.

The top priorities are resolving any critical issues listed in the Executive Summary, followed by the high-priority items in the Action Plan. Quick wins should be addressed first as they deliver the most improvement for the least effort.

Limitations

  • The headless runner does not rely on an interactive model to synthesize intermediate steps.
  • Visual analysis and PDF generation depend on Playwright Chromium being available in the environment.
  • Performance metrics use PageSpeed API data when available and deterministic heuristics when it is not.
